in_sanskrit.name: Ashvik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ash (Himavat Mountain) + Vik (power)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashvik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashvik is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ash' and 'Vik'. 'Ash' represents the Himavat Mountain, which is considered sacred in Hindu mythology. 'Vik' means power. Thus, Ashvik can be interpreted as the one who possesses the power of the sacred Himavat Mountain.
